subject: SOC 2 Type II: report request, coverage clarification, and compact evidence pack
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-03-22T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II coverage and report (Jan 1 2027 - Dec 31 2027)

Hi Vivek,

We're starting our vendor assurance review for Q2 and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027. Could you please confirm whether you have: 

- A final Type II report for that audit period, and
- A bridge letter or attestation if there have been material changes since year-end?

If you can, please also share a short manifest of the items you can provide (report, bridge letter, logs sampling, retention policy snapshot). Our preferred transfer method is a presigned S3 link, but we can accept a shared Drive folder if that's simpler.

Thanks — a bit of context helps us route this to our infosec control owners.

Best,
Lara Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Retail
[security_ops@acmecorp.com]

-----
Note: If you're sending multiple artifacts, a single CSV manifest is easiest for our intake team.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II coverage and report (Jan 1 2027 - Dec 31 2027)

Hi Lara — thanks for the note and the context. Short answers up front: 

- Yes, we have a completed SOC 2 Type II report covering Jan 1 — Dec 31, 2027.
- We maintain a bridge-letter template we can sign to cover material changes between the report date and delivery.

What we'll provide by default:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027-report.pdf (redacted where necessary)
- Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx (we can complete & sign on request)
- Evidence manifest (CSV) listing supplementary artifacts we can share on a per-request basis (log samples, retention policy snapshots, control-owner contact info).

Preferred transfer methods we support:
1) Presigned S3 link for each artifact (expires configurable) — best for automated ingestion.
2) Shared Google Drive folder (restricted access).
3) Secure file transfer / SFTP if your procurement requires it.

Minimal asks from your side to speed intake:
- Which artifacts do you need beyond the report and bridge letter (e.g., log samples, policy PDFs, configurations)?
- Data residency or handling constraints (do you need redaction or masking)?
- Point of contact for signing the NDA / evidence access (if different than security_ops).

I've attached a compact evidence manifest template and a bridge-letter draft you can review. Monica (CC) is our intake lead and will manage the transfer cadence; Karthik is happy to weigh in on telemetry samples and retention windows.

If you'd like, we can do a 20-minute sync today or tomorrow to align scope — otherwise we'll stage the report + bridge-letter first and then share manifest entries for any additional artifacts.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx]
[Attachment: evidence-manifest-template.csv]
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-03-23T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II coverage and report (Jan 1 2027 - Dec 31 2027)

Vivek — perfect, that workflow works. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) We'll need the signed bridge letter if there are operational changes after Dec 31, 2027 (routine config changes are fine; anything material needs note).
2) For evidence, our control owners usually request:
   - 30-day log sample (Redacted IDs ok)
   - Snapshot of data retention policy in effect as of 12/31/2027
   - IAM policy or role list for the service account(s) used by your runtime (high-level ok)
3) Presigned S3 links are preferred. Could you provide links that are valid for 7 days and include an HMAC expiration?

We'd like to get the report and bridge letter in the next 3 business days if possible to keep the intake window tight. Once we review, we may ask for one or two short follow-ups.

Thanks — and appreciate the template and manifest. If you can send the initial files today that would be great.

Best,
Lara
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, security_ops@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-03-23T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II coverage and report (Jan 1 2027 - Dec 31 2027)

Lara — thanks, will do. Plan below and next steps: 

Planned deliverables (today):
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027-report.pdf (full report) [Attachment stub]
- Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx (filled with current changes noted; signature pending) [Attachment stub]
- evidence-manifest-template.csv (populated with entries for the three items you asked for) [Attachment stub]

Transfer method: presigned S3 links (7-day expiry, HMAC) — Monica will send the links by EOD and include an intake CSV that maps artifact name -> control area -> contact.

One-line reply templates you can paste into your tracking system (we include these so your reviewers can intake quickly):
- "SOC 2 Type II report: uploaded (SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027-report.pdf)."
- "Bridge letter: draft uploaded; signature ETA 2 business days."
- "Log sample: 30-day redacted bundle uploaded; sample covers 2027-12-01 to 2027-12-30."

If you need a DocuSign template for the bridge letter, we can route that too — link included below.

We'll follow up in-thread with the S3 links and a short manifest mapping. Thanks for the quick turnaround on your side.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027-report.pdf; Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx; evidence-manifest-template.csv]
